g.text: Diffusion exposes fixed ions and builds an electric field across the depletion region

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c
font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #23313d

g.text: p region is left, n right. Holes initially diffuse p→n, electrons n→p. Uncovered acceptor ions on p side are negative; donor ions on n side positive, so built-in

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #23313d

g.text: field points n→p. Depletion means reduced mobile carrier density, not absence of all charge. Panels are conceptual stages, not a simulated formation transient.
